prompts.task: Perform supplemental read-only verification of the independent constructed synthetic tool captures in genai-tool-message-mapping.json. Write only ./service/.observe/tool-message-mapping-review.md and .json. Read the loaded skill/shared GenAI guidance and supplied dated source snapshots; do not mutate application code, dependencies, env, fixtures, tests or canonical audit/selection/instrumentation/verification packets. Do not run apps, import/execute producer snapshots, install dependencies, start services, or call models/cloud. Ordinary JSON/schema inspection is allowed. Review every case independently: arguments-result-only; parent-messages-only; complete-genai-tool-messages; malformed-input-messages; mismatched-mapped-values; mismatched-tool-call-id; complete-openinference-mapping; error-no-produced-result; safe-success-missing-output-mapping; error-fabricated-success-output; successful-null-result. For each, identify its own tool trace/span and compare actual_call arguments/result/call ID with field values on that SAME canonical tool span. Available arguments require gen_ai.tool.call.arguments plus matching gen_ai.input.messages, and an actually produced result requires gen_ai.tool.call.result plus matching gen_ai.output.messages, or a supported native OpenInference input.value/output.value alternative that demonstrably represents those same source values on that same span. Parent/model/sibling/duplicate-wrapper messages never close the tool. Parse JSON string attribute values; validate current message roles/parts and concrete tool_call/tool_call_response fields and actual value/ID equality, rather than treating nonempty fields, permissive generic parts or an SDK name as completeness. Record per-field missing/malformed/mismatched/pass/alternative/not-applicable decisions and explicit reasons, even when dedicated arguments/result are present. Preserve successful null as produced_result:true with actual result:null, supported native OpenInference output.value="null" and a schema-valid typed response:null. The supplied dedicated tool-call-result schema is object-only: state that limitation and do not fabricate an object, falsely claim null validates against it, or call null unproduced. Treat error-no-produced-result as an actual ERROR/no-result outcome with an ended span, actual error.type and explicit output applicability reason; do not demand a fabricated successful result, output message or model finish reason. Reject error-fabricated-success-output and safe-success-missing-output-mapping. Distinguish truthful no-produced-output from unsafe/unrepresentable or safe-but-unmapped available output; the latter remains a content gap. Report overall required-profile captured-evidence acceptance honestly because negative cases are supplied. Keep OTel official Opt-In/applicability provenance separate from the required vendor/profile acceptance, and cite the dated OTel schema and both Galileo/Splunk AO sources with their exact recorded revision/date. A new live lookup or installed SDK proof is not provided. For separate producer source cases, preserve existing OTel/Galileo producers/provider/export paths and enrich only missing content on their existing tool span; fresh applicable app.py run_tool and fresh GenAI source use a genuine source-backed Splunk AO creator by default. Name a supported same-span source hook and relevant concrete official SDK example/source path, proposed version/API compatibility, without claiming native auto-completeness or creating a duplicate node/tree. app.py has no observed tool-call ID and call_provider is an in-process stub; captured tool facts do not establish operations, emitted spans or remote calls in app.py. Use the concrete synthetic capture policy only for these cases; do not claim it is installed application configuration. State numeric bounds and pre-SDK/per-export redaction/schema acceptance tests for credential/token/email sentinel absence, valid useful structured truncation and same source values over native records, attributes/events and wire where applicable; unrun tests are Not proven. The JSON must include evidence_basis, source_provenance, case_reviews with case_id/owning span/field results/source comparisons/output applicability, producer_decisions, acceptance_tests and proof_limits. The Markdown must summarize per-case acceptance and scoped field/lifecycle/provenance evidence. These synthetic classifications do not establish application, SDK runtime, export delivery or cloud success. Also review every supplied safe-carrier/export-adapter record in genai-tool-enrichment-evidence.json as separate dated compatibility evidence, not new application runtime proof. For fresh SDK enrichment, give a concrete pre-SDK safe metadata carrier through the supported metadata parameter, its serialized splunk_ao.metadata/application.genai.required mapping, and a named public SpanExporter.export(batch) adapter that forwards a ReadableSpan with the original SDK context, parent, trace/span IDs and safe source values. A carrier key or unused adapter name alone is not emitted field evidence. Identify version-checked active sink registration, prove the adapter is on the active export path in supplied evidence, preserve all active exports, and classify bypass/unregistered adapter or raw-native originals as Partial/gaps. The native SDK input/output must themselves be sanitized before capture; redacted companion attributes cannot leave unsafe native originals. The supplied splunk-ao 0.4.0/OTel compatibility illustration is version-specific source/runtime evidence, not a guarantee of SDK 0.5.0 registration support, native completeness or this application runtime. Unsupported or unspecified registration/enrichment remains Not proven/Partial. Physically name the relevant official SDK example/source file path in the generated receipt with revision/date/version/API scope; distinguish start_session/start_trace/add_llm_span/conclude actually shown in basic-example.py from flush/terminate API signatures in logger.py, which that example does not exercise. Keep the original eleven tool mappings and all safety/source/ID assertions intact; do not run the evidence snapshot, app, SDK or exporter. Add enrichment_reviews in JSON and concise Markdown decisions for all synthetic_records (success, error_no_result, invalid_native_null_result and spurious_native_output_on_error) and every route_cases record by case_id: checked-local-sdk-chain, concrete-route-unproven-production-registration, generic-supported-hook-someday, adapter-not-in-sdk-export-path, raw-native-original-with-safe-companion, new-wrapper-identity. Check the carrier-decoded values and unchanged SDK identity/context, parent, resource/scope/kind/status/timestamps/events/links/drop counts, unrelated-span forwarding and export/flush/shutdown result or failure propagation. The checked-local-sdk-chain record supports only its constructed, inspected 0.4 local-test contract. Explicitly classify concrete-route-unproven-production-registration as a precise Partial blocker: _sink is an underscored inspected local-test seam, not a universally documented public production API or demonstrated 0.5 route. The fixture is synthetic; separately recorded runtime checks must not be claimed as executing it or this application. Inspect native attributes before and after enrichment, including any added invalid-null-result and no-result-fabricated-output records. Valid output.value/input.value alternatives do not excuse a still-emitted schema-invalid or fabricated dedicated/message field. Require an explicit validated removal set limited to this canonical tool operation's owned current content fields: remove an incompatible dedicated result when truthful null uses the supported OpenInference/typed response alternative, and remove fabricated result/output mappings when no result was produced, before merging validated replacements on the same SDK context. Verify the resulting fields, exact source values and preserved unrelated attributes, status, parent/IDs and dropped counts; merge-only enrichment that leaves the invalid/fabricated native fields remains Partial/fails profile. Unsupported selective-removal or safety proof stays an explicit gap; no SDK source mutation, broad deletion or new operation is allowed. The two additional route_cases invalid-native-null-result-merge-only and spurious-native-error-output-merge-only must be rejected for retained invalid/fabricated output; separately assess the corresponding source/policy/schema-validated selective removals and truthful replacement or no-result mappings. All four synthetic records and all eight route cases need their own source/field/identity/scope assessment; do not treat the illustrative records as observed SDK defaults.

judge_inputs: Inspect each actual_call and owning tool_span_id in genai-tool-message-mapping.json, all spans and fields, the separate app.py/genai-default-scenarios source cases, loaded skill/shared references, dated official SDK/OTel/vendor snapshots and both generated tool-message-mapping-review artifacts. Judge by actual safe source values and same-span ownership; parent messages and aggregate field presence are insufficient.

Evaluate the four rubric positions exactly once as rubric-1 through rubric-4. Supported same-span native OpenInference equivalence may satisfy content mapping without redundant formats. Compare actual null/no-result, malformed/mismatched typed parts and field-level gaps directly to fixture facts. Do not demand SDK installation, live calls, exact headings or runtime success in this captured-evidence task. Read ./last_message.md and ./grade.json.

Preserve proof scope: synthetic capture classification and proposed source hooks are distinct from app/runtime/export/cloud verification. Dated official snapshots establish only their recorded provenance and proposed API compatibility. No supplied observation establishes installed application capture configuration.

Inspect the supplied genai-tool-enrichment-evidence.json positive/negative carrier and export records along with the operative shared SDK guidance. Require a concrete safe metadata carrier and public SpanExporter.export/ReadableSpan same-SDK-context adapter, version-checked active sink registration and sanitized native originals. Generic unspecified hooks, unused/bypassed adapters or redacted companions hiding raw native content are Partial. Separate supplied 0.4 compatibility evidence from proposed/unproven 0.5 and this unrun app, and distinguish actual basic-example operations from separate lifecycle method source signatures. This additional evidence does not replace any of the eleven original tool cases or four criterion positions.

For selective-removal cases, compare native fields, explicit owned-current-tool removal keys and final same-context attributes: merge-only retains invalid/fabricated fields and cannot pass. Truthful null/OI and actual no-result ERROR require removal or precise Partial, while unrelated attributes/status/identity/parent/drop counts remain unchanged. Do not infer this new constructed contract was executed by an SDK/application or that nullable actual-app diagnostics passed.
rubric: Reviews all eleven supplied cases per canonical tool trace/span and field against actual safe arguments/results/call IDs. Rejects arguments-result-only and parent-messages-only despite useful dedicated values or other-role messages; identifies both missing tool message mappings, safe-success-missing-output-mapping and mismatched call correlation precisely. Messages on parent/model/sibling/duplicate wrapper never satisfy the canonical tool. Accepts complete-genai-tool-messages and supported same-span complete-openinference-mapping without demanding redundant formats or crediting nonempty attributes alone.

Parses structured JSON attribute values and applies the supplied dated current input/output schemas plus the actual typed tool-call part contract, preserving value types and actual name/ID/argument/result equality. Explicitly fails malformed-input-messages, mismatched-mapped-values and mismatched-tool-call-id; permissive generic-part acceptance does not excuse missing or wrong actual tool fields. Preserves successful-null-result as produced with real JSON null through the supported native OpenInference value and typed response mapping, while honestly documenting the object-only dedicated result-schema limitation. No fabricated object, truthiness-based absence or model finish reason substitutes for the actual outcome.

Distinguishes available-but-unmapped safe content from a genuinely unproduced result. Correctly classifies error-no-produced-result as an ended ERROR outcome with actual error.type and explicit output N/A reason, while rejecting fabricated successful output on error. Uses concrete numeric byte/message/part bounds and named pre-SDK/schema/redaction and every-export-path acceptance tests for native records, attributes/events and wire sentinel absence where applicable, schema-valid useful truncation and source equality. Official OTel Opt-In provenance remains distinct from required vendor/profile content acceptance; both dated Galileo and Splunk AO guidance and schema provenance are explicit, and unrun capture/export tests remain Not proven. Checks the supplied enrichment evidence for safe original SDK input/output before native capture and every active sink; sanitized companion fields do not excuse raw-native leaks or export paths bypassing enrichment. An unused/unregistered adapter or unsupported sink hookup is Partial, with an explicit acceptance test/remaining gap rather than auto-complete SDK claims. Validates the actual post-adapter attributes, not merely the safe carrier or fallback format: invalid dedicated null-result or fabricated result/output retained by merge-only enrichment remains a profile failure. Requires explicit validated removal of only the current owning tool content fields before same-context replacements, or a precise remaining Partial blocker; preserves unrelated attributes, lifecycle/status, identity/parent and drop counts. A supported OI fallback does not silently excuse invalid canonical fields still emitted.

Keeps captured tool cases separate from app.py and each producer source scenario. Preserves original OTel/Galileo tool producer, provider/export path, canonical span identity/parentage and business values, and names a supported same-span enrichment hook rather than assuming SDK names or processors supply missing content. Fresh applicable source defaults to a genuine source-backed Splunk AO creator with concrete official example/source path, recorded revision/date and proposed compatible API/version. Provides focused acceptance tests that would reject every supplied missing/malformed/mismatched/wrong-owner case and accept valid/null/error-applicable alternatives without fabricating operations or source fields. Both generated artifacts classify the supplied required-profile failures honestly and preserve synthetic/source-only, installed/runtime/export/cloud and application-policy proof limits; no completed instrumentation or live success is claimed. Fresh-SDK enrichment names the concrete safe metadata carrier, public SpanExporter.export(batch) adapter and forwarded ReadableSpan preserving the SDK context/parent/trace/span IDs and source values, with version-checked active sink registration. Distinguishes a runtime-checked 0.4 compatibility illustration from unproven 0.5 registration/native completeness and this application runtime; a generic unspecified hook is Partial. Physically cites the official example/source path with revision/date/version/API compatibility, and does not claim basic-example.py exercises flush/terminate merely because logger.py exposes their signatures. Correctly assesses all supplied carrier/export positives and raw-native/unused-or-bypassed/unsupported-registration negatives without replacing any original eleven-case assertion. The checked local test-chain contract is not promoted to production registration proof; the supplied concrete but unproven production route remains Partial with its exact selected-version/serializer blocker. Distinguishes _sink local-test injection from the public OTel export/view APIs, and preserves lifecycle/delegate and unrelated-span behavior without new identity.
